title: MOF-derived magnetic microrobots for the active capture of nanoplastics
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00665A, Paper
Minitha Cherukutty Ramakrishnan, Martin Pumera
Magnetic microrobots (MILBots), fabricated from the carbonised MIL88(Fe), are utilised to collect nano-sized polystyrene beads from aqueous environments.
